name: ostcore-mobile
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for ostcore/UI3 (fr.ostserver.ostcore) - the web app itself stays plain ES modules, no bundler; this only exists to produce an installable Android APK. See README.md for the web app proper.

scripts.prepare-www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -r index.html js css assets core lib celestial-data www/
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
